a, b, c, d = target
def _dense(M):
    return M.toarray() if hasattr(M, 'toarray') else np.asarray(M)
# The reduced density matrix of the superblock has an exactly degenerate
# eigenvalue spectrum (an SU(2) multiplet), so the eigenbasis inside that
# degenerate subspace - and hence the entrywise values of the transformed
# connection operators - is mathematically undetermined (fixed only by an
# arbitrary orthogonal rotation). Score the physically meaningful,
# basis-gauge-invariant quantities instead of raw matrix entries.
od = newblock.operator_dict
Ht = _dense(c['H']); Szt = _dense(c['conn_Sz']); Spt = _dense(c['conn_Sp'])
H = _dense(od['H']); Sz = _dense(od['conn_Sz']); Sp = _dense(od['conn_Sp'])
assert np.allclose(newblock.length, a)
assert np.allclose(newblock.basis_size, b)
assert np.allclose(energy, d)
assert np.allclose(np.linalg.eigvalsh(H), np.linalg.eigvalsh(Ht))
assert np.allclose(np.linalg.svd(Sz, compute_uv=False), np.linalg.svd(Szt, compute_uv=False))
assert np.allclose(np.linalg.svd(Sp, compute_uv=False), np.linalg.svd(Spt, compute_uv=False))
# v2.1: separate spectra do not enforce a shared operator basis.
# Keep all previous checks and additionally require one unitary U for the
# whole tuple: A = U.conj().T @ A_ref @ U, for H, Sz, and Sp.
_ref_ops = [np.asarray(A, dtype=complex) for A in (Ht, Szt, Spt)]
_out_ops = [np.asarray(A, dtype=complex) for A in (H, Sz, Sp)]
_n = Ht.shape[0]
_eye = np.eye(_n, dtype=complex)
assert all(A.shape == (_n, _n) and np.isfinite(A).all()
           for A in _ref_ops + _out_ops)
# For this fixed four-dimensional fixture the joint intertwiner has a
# one-dimensional nullspace. Solve A_ref X = X A using column-major vec(X).
# Include adjoints (in particular Sp^dagger) so the constraints are *-closed.
_pairs = list(zip(_ref_ops, _out_ops))
_pairs += [(A.conj().T, B.conj().T) for A, B in zip(_ref_ops, _out_ops)]
_constraints = []
for _A, _B in _pairs:
    _scale = max(1.0, np.linalg.norm(_A, 'fro'), np.linalg.norm(_B, 'fro'))
    _constraints.append((np.kron(_eye, _A) - np.kron(_B.T, _eye)) / _scale)
_, _, _vh = np.linalg.svd(np.vstack(_constraints), full_matrices=False)
_X = _vh[-1].conj().reshape((_n, _n), order='F')
_left, _sx, _right = np.linalg.svd(_X)
assert _sx[-1] > 1e-10 * _sx[0], "62.5: no nonsingular common basis map"
_basis_U = _left @ _right
assert np.allclose(_basis_U.conj().T @ _basis_U, _eye, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8)
for _A, _B in zip(_ref_ops, _out_ops):
    assert np.allclose(_basis_U.conj().T @ _A @ _basis_U, _B,
                       rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8), "62.5: operators do not share one basis"
